programme.desc: S02 E07 — The Pact Stacy began to mend the relationship she had with her mom following her cancer diagnosis; her mother succumbed to her illness, she believes a number of paranormal occurrences are a testament to the love they have for each other.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries: Family Spirits

programme.desc: S01 E05 — New York Super Storms Part 2 Across North America and the rest of the world, hurricanes, storm surges, earthquakes and sea level rise threaten major cities and lead to natural catastrophes.
programme.title: Brink of Disaster

programme.desc: The Montreal UFO Check out dozens of eyewitness accounts of a large, glowing, boomerang-shaped object that visited a Montreal hotel for more than three hours; learn why even police who saw this UFO could not explain how or why it appeared in the sky.
programme.title: UFO Chronicles

programme.desc: Rendlesham Forest Incident Visit Britain's version of Roswell, New Mexico, where a series of reported sightings have been linked with alleged UFO landings; hear from a US Air Force base commander who describes what he saw and why he thinks it could have been an alien craft.
programme.title: UFO Chronicles

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Tower Of Skulls Archaeologists working at the Templo Mayor temple complex in Mexico, which was once located at the very center of the Aztec Empire, unearthed a chilling find, a tower made of over 600 human skulls.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Ghost Attacks After taking over an old farm, a man is assaulted by the spirits of the former owners; a man is tormented by a demon for over 20 years; a woman is attacked by the ghost of someone close to her.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Pirate Skeletons & Fairy Coffins Learn who sailed on a sunken, treasure-filled pirate ship and who invoked the devil on a medieval curse tablet; Investigate 17 mini-coffins that have puzzled Scottish historians since 1836 and look inside a mysterious well of bones in Athens.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S02 E15 — Ghost Dogs and More Beloved pets visit their owners from beyond the grave; a poltergeist moves chairs in a sports bar; and a couple is interrupted by an uninvited dinner ghost.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: Here begins as a hunt for a paranormal research facility in America's most haunted state turns into a journey filled with discoveries for a team of supernatural investigators.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Simon Gregson The team embarks on an action-packed investigation at the home of actor Simon Gregson in Wilmslow, Cheshire.
programme.title: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Ancient Civilizations Come across a set of disturbingly familiar stone monoliths in Colombia, then explore a lost city in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta; puzzle over an ancient ruin in Corinth, Greece, and explore an old structure on a Maltese island.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Spiritual Portals Exploring towns where tragedy has opened the door to another world; feeling unsettling energy in a Mo., secret society building; seeing an innocent game turn supernatural near Philly; stepping into a Ga., B & B where scary spirits check in nonstop.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown
